About the author

Jennifer Lynn Barnes

58 books63.6k followers
Jennifer Lynn Barnes (who mostly goes by Jen) was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma. She has been, in turn, a competitive cheerleader, a volleyball player, a dancer, a debutante, a primate cognition researcher, a teen model, a comic book geek, and a lemur aficionado. She's been writing for as long as she can remember, finished her first full book (which she now refers to as a "practice book" and which none of you will ever see) when she was still in high school, and then wrote Golden the summer after her freshman year in college, when she was nineteen.

Jen graduated high school in 2002, and from Yale University with a degree in cognitive science (the study of the brain and thought) in May of 2006. She'll be spending the 2006-2007 school year abroad, doing autism research at the University of Cambridge in the United Kingdom.

🎲"Millions at stake. Hearts on the line. One game to rule them all"

Welcome back to Hawthorne island🏝️
- where secrets whisper through the walls, alliances shift like sand, money talks, trust combusts, and the only rule that matters is: win at all costs🎭

In the heart-pounding sequel to The Grandest Game,Seven came to play a billionaire’s twisted legacy. Now only five remain. And the deeper they go, the darker it gets🕵🏻‍♀️—and every single one is hiding something. But the Grandest Game isn’t just about riddles and riches anymore. It’s about survival.

♟️ Loyalties will be tested.
🗝️ Mysteries will unravel.
🔥 And rivals? They’ll burn brighter—and deadlier—than ever.

As the clock ticks down and Hawthorne House tightens its grip, one thing becomes clear: this isn’t just a game.


🎲What’s at Stake:

📌-5 players left out of 7.
📌-Endless secrets.
📌-Twisted rivalries.
And the kind of tension that makes you want to scream into a velvet cushion..
📌-Lyra Kane is back. So is Grayson “I never wanted you to stop calling” Hawthorne.
📌-Savannah’s sharpening her knives.
📌-Rohan’s making his next move.
📌-The riddles are harder, the stakes are higher, and the trust? Absolutely obliterated.
📌-And someone’s always watching, judging,👁️ The Watcher knows your secrets..and probably plotting your emotional demise..
📌-Odette — the girl who left...but maybe never really did
📌- Brady & Knox — ex-friends now battling it out like it’s personal (because it is)
📌-📜 And one dead girl’s legacy haunting everyone like a riddle-shaped ghost
📌-🗝️ Alice Hawthorne — allegedly dead, possibly watching from a hidden camera!?


So yes.
📖 I got my copy early.
👀 I’m already spiraling.

🎭 Let the games resume... and this time, it’s personal!


🎬The Vibe?

📺 The Traitors + The Inheritance Games + a hint of Cruel Intentions

Cinematic. Cutthroat. Candlelit betrayal meets luxe riddles.
A masquerade ball where every smile is a secret.
Private jets, secret tunnels, and emotional warfare in designer suits.
✨Think Knives Out but every character’s in love with someone they shouldn't trust.

The stakes? Higher.
The game? Twistier.
My grip on reality? Barely hanging on.

🥂 Who will win? Who will lose? And who will burn everything down just to feel something?
Let’s play.
This Universe just got messier, and I’m here for every glorious second🤸🏻‍♀️
Let the second round begin.
And may the most ruthless heart win.

📚 Glorious Rivals by Jennifer Lynn Barnes
🎲 The Grandest Game #2
🎧 Narrated by Anjali Kunapaneni, Christine Lakin, Zachary Webber & Maxwell Hamilton

My brain is SCREAMING. That ending??? RUDE.
I’m not okay 😭 This sequel delivered more than I expected—and while it’s technically about the game, let’s be real... I was here for the dynamics.

Let’s break it down, shall we?

🖤 Lyra & Grayson = soulmates. They’re my top couple and I’m standing by it. Grayson finally let himself feel and Lyra matched him step for step. Their scenes? Emotionally loaded, sharp, and unforgettable. He’s healing, he’s choosing her, and it shows.

💢 Jameson… we need to talk.
He’s always been messy, but here?? He straight up punched Grayson and treated Lyra like garbage. I don’t care if he’s spiraling about Avery—you don’t sabotage your own brother’s happiness like that. He acted like Grayson can’t love Lyra and still love his family. No excuses.
And Avery siding with him?? I am sick of it. Stop pushing Grayson away when all he’s ever done is put you first.

💞 Rohan & Savannah—surprisingly hit.
Okay, hot take: I actually liked Savannah in this book. Her beef with Avery? Still tired. But her emotions felt real for once, and I get her now.
Rohan?? He gave up his chance so Savannah could win and that scene made me feel things. Like... did he just prove he has a heart by losing??? GIVE ME MORE OF THEM.

💥 Gigi & Slate are everything.
No crumbs. I ate their dynamic up. Is it romantic? Platonic? Do I care? No, I just need more. Also justice for Gigi—she’s Xander-coded and I’m obsessed.

🔍 The book’s big threats? Shifting.
Eve felt less scary, and Slate seemed more... human? Which is fine because Calla Lily's organization is the new final boss energy. It had new enemies, deeper stakes, and a threat building for the finale.

🎲 The game itself? Still twisty.
Savannah winning??? SHOCK. But the why made it hit harder—because Rohan gave her the win to prove something emotional, not strategic. The series finally took a step from just puzzles to emotions driving moves.

✍️ Final thoughts:
This book was fast-paced, addictive, and full of characters evolving in real time. Grayson had the best arc. Lyra stayed iconic. Jameson? Needs therapy. Savannah and Rohan grew on me. Gigi carried. Slate gave ✨ intrigue ✨.

Jennifer Lynn Barnes knows how to write tension, emotion, and a high-stakes game. And now I’m left yelling at my wall because THAT CLIFFHANGER??? I’ll see you in a year. (crying)

━━━━━━━━━━━⊱♡⊰━━━━━━━━━━

I swear Jennifer is milking this series like it’s her full-time job—but you know what? I’m eating it up anyway 😭. I need my morally dubious rich kids fighting over puzzles, knives, and each other’s trust issues.

🏝️ Back to Hawthorne Island we go — where secrets breathe, riddles kill, and enemies maybe kiss???

Millions on the line. Hearts up for auction. 5 players left.
🕵🏻‍♀️ More lies. More betrayal. More Grayson Hawthorne content, please and thank you.

If you see me spiraling, no you don’t.
Let the rivals get glorious.
I’m pressing play the second I survive my exams.

⭑𓂃 ⌗ my thoughts
welcome to the glorious rivals rant!

i. ⌇ ⌗ section one of the rant ㆍノ

the riddles & puzzles were interesting as always—how does jlb come up with all of them? she's lowkey a genius. I honestly wish my brain worked like those characters' because all of them are so smart. though not gonna lie, whenever things got too confusing, I kinda spaced out & was taken out of the story for a moment. plus, there were times when I cared less about the mystery itself unfolding, and more about the characters—especially lyra & gray!! like they're actually the only ones that I'm paying 100% attention to. I need more of them 🙂‍↕️

ii. ⌇ ⌗ section two of the rant ㆍノ

anyway, overall this book was...quite meh. not as good as I expected it to be which was quite a let down since it was one of my most anticipated releases of this year. it had lots of boring parts where I had to fight the urge to skim through the chapters—especially rohan's pov! I just didn't care about it. I was here ONLY AND ONLY for lyra and grayson. their povs were everything, and I hope they'll get their happy ending, because they deserve it.

iii. ⌇ ⌗ section three of the rant ㆍノ

ngl, jameson pissed me off at the end. I get that with what happened to avery his emotions were all over the place & it was anger speaking through him since avery is so precious to him, and means everything to him, especially since he was already really close to losing her before. I totally understand that he went through something traumatic in prague which he can't really fully understand himself, as he doesn't remember much, but it still didn't make it okay to take out all of his rage on grayson & lyra. gray had absolutely every right to want to know the truth, and in the end jameson blamed him for everything when none of what happened was either his or lyra's fault. what's more, he knows damn well that family's everything to gray and all he wants is to protect all of them until his last breath, but jamie decided to use it so cruelly against him, and he treated gray as if he wasn't a part of the family anymore. like yeah throw a brick at me, will you? I was NOT ready for their fallout—jlb tearing the hawthorne brothers apart once again wasn't really on my 2025 bingo 💔 however, gray didn't deserve anything of that. so jameson stfu, don't push my buttons. IT'S. NOT. ON. LYRA. AND. GRAY. like why did he think that saying "alice" out loud was gonna bring hell upon them 🤨 babe, that's not how it works. she's not gonna materialize in front of you the moment you say it. anyway, I'm definitely on lyragray's side when it comes to this—no matter how much you love jameson (hell, I'm #teamjameson myself) you have to admit that it was really unfair to hold both lyra and grayson responsible for something they DIDN'T even have control over.

iv. ⌇ ⌗ section four of the rant ㆍノ

jamie was so anti lyra in this book, which I quite don't understand, because he and avery acted like the biggest lyragrayson shippers in tgg. they made him draw her, so they knew what they were doing...and here, jameson's opinion of lyra completely changed—it happened in a blink of an eye. he started blaming her for digging deeper into the mystery, and acting as if she was his biggest enemy or something, and she literally did nothing to him—she's only a breathing soul who wants to find out the truth about her dad. and what happened to him is so intriguing, I can't wait for it to get finally fully explained 👀 my heart genuinely broke for jameson and grayson though—they were finally getting to a good place, and...then this whole mess happened. I know they'll find their way back to each other, because no matter how much the hawthornes argue, at the end of the day they're ready to die for one another.

v. ⌇ ⌗ section five of the rant ㆍノ

tbh, I lowkey wish jlb hadn't dragged jamie & avery that much into the grandest game. even though, I love them, and they're one of my favorite book couples ever, I think that their story unfolded and ended beautifully in the original trilogy & all the crumbs of them we've gotten ever since were absolutely enough! it's lyragray (heavy on them), savannahrohan & gigi's time to shine. so guys don't steal their spotlight!!

vi. ⌇ ⌗ section six of the rant ㆍノ

I'm lyragray #1 defender, and I won't accept any slander on my babies 🫶🏻 my boy is still haunted by not being able to talk emily out of jumping off the cliff—he even opened up about it to lyra while explaining why he had this desire to protect everyone from the cliffs. and another thing that keeps him up at night is doing nothing when the plane exploded in the hawthorne legacy, and not helping avery—being simply paralyzed & the helplessness he felt then. it's so heartbreaking honestly ☹️

vii. ⌇ ⌗ section seven of the rant ㆍノ

ALSO. one thing that literally pushes me over the edge & I get mad when people start even talking about it in the negative light is...grayson's change. people keep saying how much he changed and that he isn't the same person he used to be. yeah, that's literally the point? 💀 he's going to therapy, and finally WORKING through his TRAUMA. I know everyone is used to him being traumatized 24/7 BUT ENOUGH. of course, he won't be the same, as he was while still not having moved on from emily or then all the stuff that happened with avery and eve. he's making his way to being happy and he's finally HEALED. and that's something we should be proud of, instead of complaining that he doesn't give off the same vibes :) if you do, you've never been a real fan in the first place. so step outside the door, and make sure you didn't disappear, and don't even piss me off more than you already did.

viii. ⌇ ⌗ section eight of the rant ㆍノ

moving on, the epilogue is an amazing set up for the third book which probably will be the last, and I'm so excited for it! the epilogue was from avery's pov...she better be okay, or else me & mrs. barnes won't be having a nice talk!


ix. ⌇ ⌗ section nine of the rant ㆍノ

as for savannahrohan & gigislate. there's clearly some tension between rohan & savvy but honestly...they didn't pique my interest. I don't mind them but they're just there...existing, being their insignificant selves. but gigi & slate!! I love their dynamic—I mean, grumpy x sunshine? her brother doesn't approve him? HELL YEAH, I LOVE THAT. I had such a fun time reading their interactions. hope we get to see more of them in the next book. they'd be definitely a different kind of couple from the rest jlb has ever written, and I'm so here for it.

x. ⌇ ⌗ section ten of the rant ㆍノ

to sum up, jameson needs to shut up and get a grip. lyra & gray's pov were the best, gigi's was alright—her dynamic with slate was so funny! they made me laugh a few times, especially when gigi rated his kidnapping. and the hardest to follow since I found it to be extremely boring was rohan's! he seriously belongs in a dark romance, bye 💋

The cliffhanger KILLED ME. What the heck was that? My theory is that the “three” are Zella, Alice, and Calla. Also, where the heck is Brady? I was reading reviews and I feel like everyone forgot about the fact that he’s gonzo.


જ⁀➴“Seize the power” ▶︎ •၊၊||၊|။||||။‌‌‌‌၊|• 0:10


⤷ ゛Quotes ˎˊ˗

⋆˙⟡Lyra and Grayson
- “Instead, Grayson Hawthorne looked like something out of a dream, the kind you ached for from the moment you opened your eyes.”
- “Her voice broke on the word matter, and Grayson knew in that instant that he was going nowhere. I matter. To you. This matters.”
- “But this?” He was talking about them. “This is worth fighting for.”
- “You were wrong. I would choose you Lyra - not over my family but as a part of it.”


₊˚⊹ᰔSavannah and Rohan
- “Damn it all to hell and back.” Rohan crossed to Savannah and pressed his dice into her hands.”
- “Why is it that men can make the prospect of a woman doing what suits her sound like a cardinal sin?” (this isn’t about the two of them but I love this Savannah quote so I had to)
- “Don’t forget the part about destroying each other,” Rohan whispered. “I’m looking forward to that.”
- “Savannah Grayson wasn’t a gentle kisser. Good. Neither was he.” SCREAMING



｡𖦹°‧Gigi and Slate
- “Easy there, Sunshine.” This man could call me whatever he wanted.
- “Back up to the part where you got kidnapped.” Savannah said. “Twice.”
“And I didn’t even get a t-shirt,” Gigi quipped.” (just a Gigi quote bc I love her sm)
- “I know you’re out there,” she said again.
“No, sunshine, you don’t.”
- “Let’s play a game. It’s called You Don’t Need to Prove a Damn Thing. To anyone. It’s called You’re Already Strong.”
“Were you ever out there?”
“More than once.”


જ⁀➴”Power came, always, at a cost. The only question was what the price was-and who was going to pay it.”


⤷ ゛Notes/Additional Thoughts ˎˊ˗

We were ROBBED in Chapter 69. I don't care what you say, we were. Also, what’s all the hate on Lyra for? Grayson deserves to be happy, just let the man live. I’m obsessed with the tension between Rohan and Savannah. I KIND OF wish that they were enemies for a little longer, but other than that I’m obsessed. Grayson Hawthorne. I have no words. Him and Lyra are soulmates, and no one can convince me otherwise. Gigi and Slate; whenever there was a scene between them, I couldn’t figure out if I was supposed to be nervous for Gigi, or giggle, but I chose the latter. The nickname “sunshine”? Yes.

I understand why Jameson was so mad at the end, but bro. Grow up. Punching your brother in the face isn’t going to find Avery. Let’s handle this like adults.


⤷ ゛Final Rating ˎˊ˗

I’m rating this book a solid 4 stars. I know, I know, “But you rate almost everything four stars.” What can I say? I guess I just know my taste? 4 stars is just a practical, easy rating. The beginning was kind of slow for me, but the romanceeee! I’m dead, and so excited for the next book!!

꒰🎭꒱ glorious rivals by jennifer lynn barnes


↪ ★★★★.25 nostalgic stars

"family means you'd die for the person, and that you know damn well that they'd die for you. it means that no matter how lost you feel, no matter how dark things get, on some level, you know that there is a place and people with whom you belong."

"but for better or worse, avery kylie grambs was a hawthorne now in every way that mattered."

"help me find avery, and the money is yours - what you need and more, every dime i have, no strigs attached."

"how is libby?"
"full of cravings. a little cranky." nash grinned. "wholly incandescent."

⌗ | my review.

let's be honest, if i didn't love the tig series as much as i do, i would have rated this a solid 3 stars. the 4.25 stars are here purely because of the writing, gigi (!!), slate, gigi x slate. some rohan scenes, gray's redemption, avery x jamie cameos, and um.... what was it ..... nostalgia!!

"rohan noticed a ring on avery's right finger bearing a symbol he knew all too well: a lemniscate. infinity."

i. | overall, this book was quite... meh. i was right not to hold it up to high expectations but i guess it wasn't a total disappointment?

ii. | gigi was a ray of sunshine, as usual! and i still stand by my statement that i won't easily trust a person who hates gigi 🤷‍♀️ gigi & slate with their grumpy x sunshine dynamic .... WHEWWWW give me more of that asap omg!! love that for them.

iii. | plot is as amazing as ever, though i am a little lost about this whole 'woman in red', 'lily', 'the watcher' situation, but sure, i'll go with it! i am so here for the grayson redemption, especially after how badly jlb messed him up. he's going to therapy and his mental health is improving. just setting the record straight, i am #teamjameson but i have never hated grayson, always wanted the best for him (this feels so weird to say, especially because i'm talking about fictional characters??)

iv. | SOOOOOO i hate lyra. no further elaboration. #lyrastansplsdontcomeforme #lyrastansidonthateyou #lyrastansplsletmelive #savealmas #sendhelp #iwanttolive #ihavealifeaheadofme #freealmas

v. | lastly, let's talk about the ending. my opinion of the situation is that both jameson and grayson were wrong . jameson had a right to be upset, of course; the love of his life was kidnapped by the person who once kidnapped him (when he thought he was going to die, i might add) and he had a right to have a negative reaction. ...but, he really shouldn't have punched gray and said all that "go to hell" nonsense. that was just wrong. HOWEVER, grayson was also wrong! he was warned not to engage in the situation, and although i get that he's concerned for his family, he shouldn't have shared all that with lyra. whom he's known for 3 days. three days. three! yes, she deserves to get closure regarding her dad but gray doesn't owe her that just yet. it's been three days. and before everyone comes at me, yes, this applies to rohan & savannah as well.

"he kindapped me. it was a decent kidnapping, all things considered. three-and-a-half stars."

anyways, my take on the ending of glorious rivals:

⤷ both grayson and jameson were in the wrong. jlb ruined their relationship after they JUST got on the mend (don't know if i can forgive that just yet!)
⤷ lyra isn't my favourite, but neither is grayson, so whatever, as long as she doesn't turn out to be a bitchy psychopath who goes after avery, it doesn't make much of a difference to me
⤷ AVERY BETTER BE BACK IN TIP TOP SHAPE IN THE FINAL BOOK. DON'T YOU KILL HER OFF, JLB. i need her to be alive.

on that note! things i want to see in the gilded blade:

⤷ avery pov!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
⤷ avery x jamie reunion moment
⤷ nash x libby twins moment??
⤷ more gigi x slate pls
⤷ FIX GRAY & JAMIE'S BROTHERHOOD AGAIN
⤷ more character development for lyra because so far all i see is an ex-dancer who wants to find her dad's killer, which is cool but tells me nothing about her

"avery was the center of jameson's universe, his everything in every way that mattered."
